### SDKs

```
npm install @wazen/sdk          # TypeScript / Node.js
pip install wazen               # Python
composer require wazen/sdk      # PHP
dotnet add package Wazen        # C# / .NET
```

Need an SDK in another language? [Just ask.](mailto:saeed@wazen.dev) We'll build it even if you're the only one who needs it.
